Scope of Work: The Vendor shall realize crew seat prototype as per the dimensions and drawings attached as A nnexure I. The crew seat shall consist of Liner and Foam based system meeting the ASTM E 595 standards. Liner ma y be Aramid or Nomex cloth. The crew seat shall consist of proper fastening mechanisms like belts and loops and su pport structures. 2. Delivery Schedule: The Party shall deliver the crew seat system on staggered manner as detailed below. (a). For 1st crew seat: Intimation on the readiness of the crew seat shall be made within 3 months from the date of order for conducting pre-delivery inspection (PDI). Supply to be completed within 1 month from the date of receipt o f PDI clearance from VSSC. (b). 2nd crew seat: Intimation on the readiness of the crew seat shall be made within 6 months from the date of ord er for conducting pre-delivery inspection (PDI). Supply to be completed within 1 month from the date of receipt of P DI clearance from VSSC. (c). 3rd Crew seat: Intimation on the readiness of the crew seat shall be made within 9 months from the date of orde r for conducting pre-delivery inspection (PDI). Supply to be completed within 1 month from the date of receipt of PDI clearance from VSSC. 3. Order validity: The entire order shall be valid for a period of one year. 4. Payment term: 100% within 30 days on receipt of the item at our site on pro-ratab asis. TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS Sl. No. Parameter Specification Specifications for Foam to be used in Crew seat 1 3 90-100 Density, kg/m 2 Flammability <15 mm ( ISO 14624: 1:2003) 3 Thermal conductivity, W/m K 0.04 (maximum) 4 Outgassing properties Should meet ASTM E 595 [TML, CVCM] 5 % Ball rebound 2 - 10 Specifications of Liner to be used in Crew seat 6 Liner material Liner shall be fire retardant fabric meeting the outga ssing specifications as per ASTM E 595.
